Both prior bypasses are now closed: parseExtCommunityTypedHex (internal/core/bgp/attribute/builder_parse.go:322) calls validateOriginValidationStateExtCommunityForSend alongside ParseExtendedCommunityHex, WriteAttributesOrdered (internal/core/bgp/attribute/origin.go:290) calls zeroOriginValidationStateReservedInWireAttr for AttrExtCommunity across all UpdateBuilder variants, and filter_community/handler.go (emitCommunityOp, emitKeptCommunityValue) zeroes dirty Reserved bytes on egress Set/Add/Keep (verified by TestExtCommunityAttrModHandlerZeroesRFC8097Reserved). TestRFC8097ReservedFieldZeroOnSend (internal/component/bgp/message/rfc8097_origin_validation_state_test.go) proves positive zero-Reserved emission through NewOriginValidationStateExtCommunity, ParseSingleExtCommunity (keyword, raw hex, typed hex), ExtendedCommunities.WriteTo, and real UpdateBuilder.BuildUnicast wire PathAttributes (without mutating caller input), and negative rejection across all 5 Reserved positions [2..6] and state > 2 in both raw hex and typed hex while preserving non-0x4300 opaque communities (0x430b) verbatim. Discrimination records verify ZeroOriginValidationStateReservedBytes and parseExtCommunityTypedHex.
